summary: Absorbed multi-head latent attention (MLA) over a shared latent KV cache: every head attends over the same [latent ; rope key] rows with its absorbed query, for decode, speculative verify and prompt chunks, contiguous or paged, with an ordered split combine that keeps columns invariant
implementation_scope: A CUDA reference kernel (8 heads of one column per block, warp per head, lane per key of 32-key tiles, padded shared rows, online softmax, latent outputs owned lane-strided) over BF16 cache rows of rank + rope values (rank a multiple of 32 up to 512, width up to 640), contiguous or through a block table, with optional sinks; key tiles assigned to splits by position and an ordered combine. A Python reference of per-head attention, the absorbed query and the kernel's latent attention. Absorbed queries, W_UV, cache writes and RoPE are engine supplied.

agent_guidance.use_when: The model declares kv_lora_rank (DeepSeek-V2/V3, Kimi K2 and other DeepSeek-architecture models) and decode or verify must attend over the latent cache
agent_guidance.avoid_when: The model uses grouped-query attention, or a long prompt should take the decompressed path (ordinary flash attention over decompressed keys and values does less than a third of the work)
provides: Absorbed MLA attention over shared latent rows for any number of heads (a multiple of 8)
Contiguous and paged latent caches through Core's block tables
Column invariance: tiles assigned to splits by position and an ordered combine
A Python reference of the absorption identity
engine_supplies: Latent cache writes [c ; r] with the latent norm and RoPE on the rope key
Absorbed queries [W_UK^T q_nope ; q_rope] and W_UV after attention
The softmax scale (with the config's YaRN multiplier)
Split counts sized from the device
preserve: Tile-to-split assignment by position and the ordered combine
The cache row layout the absorbed queries match
RoPE applied to the rope key only
adapt: Tensor-core tiling of scores and outputs across heads
FP8 latent pages with per-tile scales

code_files.purpose: Reference absorbed attention kernel and ordered split combine
Per-head and absorbed latent attention, the absorbed query and cache sizes

requires.hardware: CUDA C++20 on sm_80 or later; Python 3.11+ for the reference
requires.model: Multi-head latent attention with kv_lora_rank a multiple of 32 up to 512 and rank + rope up to 640, heads a multiple of 8
requires.workload: Decode, speculative verify and short prompt chunks over a latent cache

contract.input: Absorbed BF16 queries [T][heads][rank + rope], BF16 latent rows, an optional block table, positions, scale, optional sinks and split scratch
contract.ownership: The engine owns every buffer; kernels borrow them on the caller's stream
contract.failure: Unsupported widths, head counts, split counts and null buffers are rejected at launch
contract.core_boundary: Core's ModelConfig::mla declares the widths; StateCache block tables address paged latent rows

validation.host: The absorbed form equals per-head attention over decompressed keys and values; cache-size arithmetic
validation.native: DeepSeek-V3 widths (16 heads) and a smaller geometry, contiguous and paged, with and without sinks, three verify columns over five splits against an FP64 reference, each column alone bit for bit equal to the verify; rejected shapes
validation.performance: No speed claim; reference SIMT kernel
